speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Thrombocythemia. The clinical picture of fatigue, dizziness, digital pain relieved by cold (suggesting digital ischemia/Grey Turner sign), and the specific blood finding of thrombocytosis with abnormal platelets on smear is classic for a myeloproliferative neoplasm, not iron deficiency anemia. Please proceed with a JAK2 V617F mutation test to confirm.
